unit.why: A short memorate: a descendant staying with the rebbe during his illness sees him at night holding his beard and weeping, and the rebbe senses him and explains why he weeps.
unit.boundary_note: thematically continues the previous division (rebbe's wish to set all Hasidim right before his death) but is a self-contained anecdote

stories.start_quote: וככה סיפר א' מצאצאיו הקדושים שלן
stories.summary_en: A descendant staying with the ill rebbe creeps barefoot to his bed at night and finds him weeping while holding his beard. The rebbe senses him and explains that he weeps because he wishes to set all his Hasidim right before his death, so that none of them enters the world to come in shame.
